item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01645","case1_error":"Models five child and five adult tickets instead of three child and two adult tickets.","case2_error":"Leading answer 300 conflicts with the correct derivation and total of 840.","reason":"The first has an erroneous ticket-count equation; the second has only an answer-marker conflict.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01646","case1_error":"Reports 72 ounces of prepared beverage instead of applying the ratio to obtain 9 ounces of tea ingredient.","case2_error":"Treats capacity for 2000 photos as 2000 kilobytes, omitting conversion by 1.5 kilobytes per photo.","reason":"The first answers the wrong quantity; the second misrepresents storage capacity by confusing photo count with kilobytes.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01647","case1_error":"Gives unsupported incorrect final numbers after correct cost and equal-split formulas; the correct share is $25.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported incorrect final numbers after correct sales formulas; the correct total is $205.","reason":"Both supply incorrect numbers after correct formulas without showing calculations that establish a more specific arithmetic error.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01648","case1_error":"Counts only 10 ad spaces overall, omitting that each of three companies purchased 10.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correct expression 34 − 8 − 9 as 27 instead of 17.","reason":"The first omits a multiplicity factor in modeling the total; the second numerically evaluates a correctly written expression incorrectly.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01649","case1_error":"Appends unsupported answer 13 after a correct average formula; the actual average is 9.","case2_error":"Uses the invalid counting equation 2x + (26 − 8 − 3) = 26 instead of x + 8 − 3 = 26.","reason":"The first gives an unsupported number after correct formulas; the second explicitly constructs an erroneous relation.","judgment":"different"}]}
